label: idScheme
comment: the identifier scheme as defined by the registrar that manages the identifier registry. Eg abr.busines.gov.au If the identifier scheme is registered with UNTP then this URI can use used to dicsover the resolution method (to get more data) and the verification method (to prove ownership).
